fact: The IMF report records that the expenditure chain software is to be activated in four pilot sector ministries by June 2025 and extended to four more by October 2025, that LOGIRAD and an integrated tax ERP at the DGI are being deployed, and that SIGeFiP is targeted for September 2027.
title: Democratic Republic of Congo: Requests for an Arrangement under the ECF and RSF, IMF Country Report No. 25/23
